name: There's something wrong with my lamp
source:
After finding something off with your family's new lamp you become addicted to staring at it.

Will you be able to break free and find the truth? or will you become trapped forever? 

[From [url=https://objective-rebel.itch.io/theres-something-wrong-with-my-lamp]Itch.io[/url]]
